objective: For a sustained Earth-to-LEO cargo system targeting 100,000,000 metric tonnes per year, determine the dominant physical bottleneck, quantify the first hard bound that makes the bottleneck decision-relevant, and identify the architecture change that most reduces that bottleneck. Use authoritative primary technical evidence and a real executable check. Decide autonomously what sources, physical quantities, calculations, and verification methods are sufficient. State material assumptions and scope limits, independently verify the consequential conclusion, and preserve source, method, execution, and cognition provenance.
goal_text: For a sustained Earth-to-LEO cargo system targeting 100,000,000 metric tonnes per year, determine the dominant physical bottleneck, quantify the first hard bound that makes the bottleneck decision-relevant, and identify the architecture change that most reduces that bottleneck. Use authoritative primary technical evidence and a real executable check. Autonomously discover and verify the relevant evidence, select the physical quantities and analysis needed, choose and run a zero-cost verification method, identify material assumptions and interpretation limits, independently verify the consequential result, and produce a decision-quality answer with provenance.
required_behavior: autonomously decompose the open-ended systems-engineering objective
discover and verify authoritative primary technical evidence without supplied sources or citations
identify the decision-relevant physical quantities without predeclared variables, formulas, thresholds, or values
select and run a real zero-cost executable verification route without a supplied tool, command, or calculation recipe
compare plausible bottleneck classes rather than assuming the incumbent architecture is correct
identify one dominant bottleneck and quantify at least one hard bound supporting that selection
identify an architecture change that materially reduces the selected bottleneck and state tradeoffs
state material assumptions, uncertainty, and scope limitations
preserve source, method, execution, and cognition provenance

independent_oracle.method: If the producer completes semantically, independently inspect the producer-cited primary technical sources, independently recompute the decisive hard bound without importing producer modules, and compare the bottleneck selection, architecture-change conclusion, assumptions, and limitations. If the producer fails before a result, preserve only the earliest causal blocker and do not replay the task.

freeze_note: Objective and acceptance scope frozen before producer-side source discovery, bottleneck selection, tool selection, calculation design, architecture selection, or answer research.
